parallels.note: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

people.name: Ephron
people.line: A Hittite who sold a burial site to Abraham.

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

people.name: Machpelah
people.line: A cave near Hebron; burial place of patriarchs

people.name: Mamre
people.line: A place near Hebron; associated with Abraham

translations.web: Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is near Mamre,
translations.bsb: His sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah near Mamre, in the field of Ephron son of Zohar the Hittite.
translations.kjv: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre;
translations.asv: And Isaac and Ishmael his sons buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which is before Mamre.
